brief.text: An old orchard keeper goes out to the stable on a frozen morning. Her pony is very old now and the vet is coming. She kneels in the straw and rolls one red apple to the mare. We cut on the same apple lying in summer grass forty years earlier, the pony young, the woman young. It ends on the hill at dusk, the two of them sharing apple slices by the wall.

script.logline: On the morning the vet is due, an old orchard keeper rolls one last apple to her old pony, and the apple carries us back to the summer they were both young.
script.emotionalCore: She kneels in the straw and rolls a red apple to the mare: the small daily gift, offered one more time.
script.arc: A frozen stable and a goodbye she cannot say. She rolls an apple across the boards. A match cut on the apple opens a summer orchard where both are young. It ends quietly on the hill at dusk.

characters.name: Ilse
characters.baseDescription: a 71-year-old woman, 163 cm tall, 58 kg, narrow and upright, long white hair in one thick plait over her shoulder, pale grey-green eyes, a small white scar across her chin
characters.wardrobe: mustard-yellow knitted cardigan with wooden toggle buttons, faded blue cotton headscarf, brass pocket knife on a green cord around her neck, wicker basket on her left arm

states.label: present day, worn out
states.description: tired, hands red and chapped from the cold, mud on her boots and on the hem of the cardigan, the left pocket torn at one corner

states.label: flashback, young summer
states.description: rested and clean, the cardigan new with bright unfaded wool, a wide unguarded smile

characters.name: Fenna
characters.baseDescription: a dapple-grey pony mare, 27 years old, 142 cm at the withers, about 380 kg, a white star on her forehead, a dark mane, a small nick in her right ear
characters.wardrobe: worn red leather halter with a brass nameplate, plaited blue wool browband

states.label: present day, very old
states.description: old and stiff but dignified, a sagging back, a cloudy left eye, a thin dull winter coat

states.label: flashback, young
states.description: young and strong, a glossy dappled coat, both eyes clear and dark, alert ears

locations.name: Winter stable
locations.description: an old timber stable at dawn, loose straw over worn floorboards, frost on the small window, a stall door with FENNA painted on it
locations.lighting: thin blue dawn light through the frosted window, breath visible in the cold air
locations.cameraPackage: cinema camera, 35mm, T1.8, gentle handheld sway
locations.palette: cold slate blue, pale straw gold

locations.name: Hilltop wall

locations.lighting: dusk after sunset, soft peach and lavender sky, low even light

locations.name: Summer orchard
locations.description: rows of old apple trees in long uncut grass, fallen apples, a wooden ladder against a trunk
locations.lighting: high summer sun through the leaves, dappled light on the grass
locations.palette: deep green, apple red, honey yellow

locations.name: Cottage kitchen

locations.lighting: warm lamp light against a dark blue window before dawn
locations.palette: warm amber, dark blue, scrubbed pine

scenes.title: The stable door
scenes.actionSimple: Ilse stands in the stable door at dawn holding the halter rope, her breath misting

scenes.title: The mare in her stall
scenes.actionSimple: the old mare shifts her weight off the bad leg, ears flicking toward the door

scenes.title: An old pony breathing
scenes.actionSimple: Fenna lowers her head and lets out one slow breath through her nose

scenes.title: One apple
scenes.actionSimple: she kneels in the straw, takes a red apple from her pocket and rolls it toward the mare

scenes.title: The apple stops
scenes.actionSimple: the apple wobbles through the straw and stops against her front hoof

scenes.title: The same apple in summer
scenes.actionSimple: the same apple lies in long grass, the young mare drops her head and takes it

scenes.title: The basket goes over
scenes.actionSimple: the young mare nudges the basket over, young Ilse falls back in the grass laughing

scenes.title: Up the hill
scenes.actionSimple: old Ilse leads old Fenna up to the wall, one hand on her neck, the light going

scenes.title: Last light
scenes.actionSimple: two shapes by the pear tree, she holds out an apple slice, the mare takes it gently

script.inspiration: A small story about an old animal and the person who loves it: soft light, one ordinary object carrying the cut between two eras.
